//go:build functional

package authoritystore

import (
 "testing"
 "time"
)

func TestExportScopedV2PhysicalFixture(t *testing.T) {
 store, err := Open("testdata/scoped-v2/authority.bolt", localIdentity(), FreshEvidence)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 defer store.Close()
 for i, replica := range []uint64{7, 8} {
  row := localCollection(replica)
  row.Grant.Key.Revision += uint64(i)
  row.Grant.Action.StepSeq += i
  row.Retirement = finishRetirementFixture(t, store, row.Grant)
  prepared, err := store.PrepareCollection(t.Context(), row)
  if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  if replica == 8 {
   if _, err := store.CompleteCollection(t.Context(), row.Retired.Identity, prepared.Sequence, time.Unix(20,0).UTC()); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  }
 }
}
